Bloom & Twine Florist Studio is a small, independent flower studio in a restored shophouse on Joo Chiat Place, in the heart of Singapore's Katong and Joo Chiat neighbourhood. It was founded in 2019 by florist Marcus Lim and crochet artist Priya Nair, with a simple idea: flowers for every kind of moment, and for every kind of lifespan. We work in four collections. Fresh flowers, flown in twice a week from Ecuador, the Netherlands and Malaysia and hand-tied in our studio, for birthdays, anniversaries, graduations and grand openings. Dried and preserved flowers that keep their beauty for a year or more without water. Soap flowers: lightly scented keepsakes that look real and never wilt. And hand-crocheted flowers, made stitch by stitch from soft milk-cotton yarn by Priya and a small team of local crocheters, that last forever and suit allergy sufferers and hospital visits. Every arrangement is made to order, and we send you a photo before it leaves the studio. We deliver island-wide, with same-day delivery for orders confirmed before 12pm from Monday to Saturday, and free self-pickup from the studio. Every order comes with a free greeting card carrying your personal message. Beyond everyday gifting, we take on corporate and bulk orders (event giveaways, Teachers' Day, Women's Day and grand opening stands), wedding and ROM florals, and run small crochet flower workshops at the studio on Saturday afternoons. We're open Monday to Saturday from 9am to 7pm, and Sunday from 10am to 4pm.
